newsitem.title: GERMANY: INSTANT VIEW - German January employment data.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - German January employment data.

text.p: Following are reactions to German January employment data measuring 4.658 million people, topping predictions that the figure would exceed 4.5 million.

ARMIN KAYSER, economist at SBC Warburg, "The numbers show a structural rise in unemployment which is very worrying. Since October we have seen a sharp increase in unemployment rates and this coincides exactly with the time at which the economy started losing its dynamic. Germany currently lacks the growth momentum which is necessary to stabilise the labour market. But the Bundesbank will not act like Pavlov's dog and cut rates.
